1.e4 c6 2.d3 d5 3.Nd2 g6 4.Ngf3 Bg7 5.g3.strategy: Completes the fianchetto and gets the king ready to castle. The bishop stands behind the f3 knight and will work along the long diagonal once the centre opens, so White waits for Black to commit.
A flexible development: the knight backs up d5 and c6 and leaves the f-pawn free to advance. It does not take the f6 square, so Black keeps a free hand for the pawn break against White's centre.
